tools.name: get_cycle
tools.description: One release cycle of a product: its latest patch version, release date, LTS/support/EOL dates and whether extended support exists. Use when you already know the major version, e.g. product=nodejs cycle=24. Answers: is Node 18 still supported? What is the newest 24.x patch?

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: All release cycles for a product, newest first: latest patch version, release date, LTS status/date, end-of-life date, and end of active support. Answers: what is the CURRENT version of X? Which major versions are still supported? When does version Y reach EOL? Use exact slugs from list_products (e.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List every product slug tracked (nodejs, python, react, postgresql, ubuntu, …). Call this first when unsure of the exact product slug to pass to get_product.
